estimates: track.zones.drs: activation from telemetry (start ~ +latency/reaction, end = where the field brakes); detection points estimated (L)
track.pit.speedLimit: measured from telemetry, not an official document

track.wL/wR: lower bound from the field's lateral spread, at least the circuit default 14 m (map3d.js CIRCUIT_STYLE) – measured on 0 % of the lap (positions snapped to a line: default width everywhere)
track.line / kappaLine: minimum-curvature line between the (estimated) edges, car centre ≥ 1.3 m inside – a geometric estimate of the racing line, not measured
weather.rain: the feed's Rainfall is 0/1 – intensity is an engine estimate

track.frame: F1 Position frame in metres (feed decimetres × 0.1), not re-centred; hdg = atan2(dy, dx); + left; kappa = dhdg/ds

drsNote.how: CarData channel 45 ≥ 10 runs over green racing laps: start = 10th percentile of run starts, end = median run end; detection = estimated
